reason: Stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. deepmerge-ts 7.1.5 is pulled in only by @prisma/config, a dependency of the prisma CLI (a devDependency of packages/database that pnpm also links as the optional peer of @prisma/client). @prisma/config uses it solely as c12's merger while the CLI loads our own prisma.config.ts, with dotenv, rc files, package.json, extends and remote configs disabled, so it only ever merges that static, acyclic config object. No untrusted or recursive input reaches it, and nothing loads it at app runtime.
tracking: https://github.com/prisma/orm/issues/30295 (fix merged to Prisma's v7 branch in prisma/orm#30189). Remove when a Prisma 7.x release ships patched transitive deps.

reason: An auth-plugin downgrade to mysql_clear_password makes mysql2 send the password in cleartext to a malicious MySQL server. mysql2 3.15.3 is a dependency of the prisma CLI only, which imports mysql2/promise solely in Prisma Studio's executor for MySQL datasources. Our datasource is PostgreSQL and the runtime uses @prisma/adapter-pg + pg, so mysql2 never opens a connection to any MySQL server.
tracking: https://github.com/prisma/orm/issues/30295 (fix merged to Prisma's v7 branch in prisma/orm#30314). Remove when a Prisma 7.x release ships patched transitive deps.
